versions.provenance: FIGO staging of endometrial cancer 2023 update incorporating TCGA molecular classification; licensed clinical reference.
versions.introduction: The FIGO 2023 endometrial cancer staging system fundamentally revolutionizes gynecologic oncology by integrating molecular profiling directly into anatomical stages. Patients are categorized into 4 Proactive Molecular Risk Groups: POLE ultramutated (POLEmut - favorable; downstages I-II), Mismatch repair deficient (MMRd - intermediate; pembrolizumab eligible), No specific molecular profile (NSMP - intermediate), and p53 abnormal (p53abn - aggressive; upstages to IIC/IV).

t.label: Tumor confined to the corpus uteri and ovary (Stage IA: limited to endometrium or <50% myometrial invasion; Stage IB: >=50% myometrial invasion; Stage IC: limited to ovary with concurrent low-grade endometrium)
Tumor invades cervical stroma or demonstrates extensive lymphovascular space invasion (LVSI)
Local or regional spread (IIIA: uterine serosa/adnexa; IIIB: vagina/parametrium; IIIC: lymph node metastases)
Tumor invades bladder/bowel mucosa or distant metastases

n.label: Pelvic lymph node metastasis (IIIC1i micrometastasis <=2 mm, IIIC1ii macrometastasis >2 mm)
Para-aortic lymph node metastasis with or without pelvic nodes

m.label: Pathogenic POLE exonuclease domain mutation (exceptional prognosis; downstages Stage I-II to Stage IAm(POLEmut))
p53 abnormal / TP53 mutant (high-risk biology; Stage I-II with myometrial invasion upstaged to Stage IICm(p53abn))

stageGroups.t: Non-aggressive histology confined to endometrium or polyp
stageGroups.basis: Total hysterectomy + bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (BSO). Adjuvant therapy omitted.

stageGroups.t: <50% myometrial invasion, no or focal LVSI
stageGroups.basis: Surgical staging. Observation or vaginal brachytherapy if high-intermediate risk.

stageGroups.t: Stages I-II with pathogenic POLE mutation
stageGroups.basis: POLE ultramutated favorable biology: adjuvant therapy can be safely de-escalated/omitted even if high grade.
External beam radiation therapy (EBRT) +/- vaginal brachytherapy or systemic chemotherapy.

stageGroups.t: p53 abnormal with ANY myometrial invasion
stageGroups.basis: Upstaged to IIC due to high-risk molecular biology: Systemic chemotherapy (Carboplatin + Paclitaxel) + EBRT.
High risk of recurrence: Pelvic EBRT and systemic chemotherapy.
Chemoimmunotherapy: Pembrolizumab + Lenvatinib OR Carboplatin + Paclitaxel + Dostarlimab/Pembrolizumab (standard for MMRd/dMMR).

versions.regionalNodes: Pelvic lymph nodes and para-aortic lymph nodes. Sentinel lymph node (SLN) mapping with indocyanine green (ICG) is standard.
versions.histologicGrade: FIGO Grade 1 (<=5% solid non-squamous growth), Grade 2 (6-50% solid growth), Grade 3 (>50% solid growth).
versions.histopathologicTypes: Endometrioid adenocarcinoma, Serous carcinoma, Clear cell carcinoma, Carcinosarcoma, Undifferentiated/dedifferentiated carcinoma.
prognosticFactors: TCGA Molecular subtype: POLEmut (favorable), MMRd/MSI-H, NSMP, p53abn (unfavorable)
Histologic subtype (serous and carcinosarcoma carry high recurrence risk)
